scripts.cms:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.supabase.yml logs -f directus
scripts.cms:snapshot: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T directus npx directus schema snapshot --yes /directus/schema/snapshot.yaml
scripts.cms:apply: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T directus npx directus schema apply --yes /directus/schema/snapshot.yaml && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart directus && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait directus
